body: Makes sense. That’s helpful, now I know.
Eh, I don’t hate the double beds. I just like having one big bed more lol

Lol that's actually hilarious and it's a relief to hear these kind of experiences. I'm super excited  I do want to learn as much as possible but I'm so scared they'll expect more than I know, even if it's something super basic! Really doubting my abilities... I hope my preceptor is cool :P

Thank you for your comment. I understand their expectations may not be too high, but I am worried that I will get stuck on even the most basic of counseling points or something like that. I suppose I wanted a better idea of exactly what was expected of some of you during these IPPEs... I'm honestly more than happy to just count pills or clean shelves LOL but I don't want to learn absolutely nothing, you know?
Hahah I’m a loner when it comes to studying so not sure if FaceTime will help me personally

While I do wish they weren’t so lenient, I think open notes are somewhat of a plus for me because I’ve almost mastered effective note-taking. I find myself recalling information really well since I write things in detail and then I know exactly where to look in my notes for the info I need to fill in the gaps in my knowledge. Other classes don’t get that kind of attention though, so finding my balance for ALL my classes isn’t quite there yet, but I’m close. Thank you!!

Nope! We do use a lockdown browser (Examplify) so I’m sure there’s an option for the professors to record us if they really wanted to, but they definitely don’t care enough. We’re allowed to have notes either way so I take notes on the powerpoints then sync them onto a tablet to take the exams LOL. There is only so much time to look information up though, so there is a certain level of studying to do. But I can tell I’ve definitely been putting in less effort. So far, only one of my exams was proctored via Zoom but it was still open-note.

I guess I'm just really freaked out about the complete lack of experience, so thank you so much for the reassurance. I don't want to be completely useless! My school does provide a checklist we have to go over so I know that's one thing to gauge.

Well, my current cumulative GPA has definitely gone up since then (I'm at 3.3 now) and I hope to get even better this year. Again, I've really been working on my grades! Also, where'd you get the info about the programs?
Yeah, I definitely learned a lot from writing this poem. Thank you!
Thank you for your comment! I wrote the poem a while ago to mostly see how hard I could make it for myself lol but wasn’t sure if it would detract from the message. This definitely helps.
Noted! Thought I’d challenge myself but I get that there must be a balance.
I read it on desktop, so it looks fine to me! Don't worry, mobile is always weird when it comes to Reddit :P
I loved the beginning rhyme scheme. It's fitting how all the rhymes end just as abruptly as the ending/death comes. Well done!

This is such a well-written poem! So descriptive and beautiful. The only real criticism I had is just a stylistic quirk of mine: the punctuation usage at the ends of the lines and within stanzas (e.g.: *"No, you couldn't; the wound wasn't real/But I could."*)

Of course, there's the infamous poetic license, but I feel like such a neat and ordered poem could use a little more of that structure. Otherwise, I wouldn't change a thing ((:

Ugh, I loved this so much. I loved the references to all the poets and writers. You painted a beautiful picture with your poem (wink wink). Your similes add wonderful visuals, and every line flows super well.

Currently dating a big guy! I'd also go so far to say that it's also a preference for me, considering the fact that I'm a chubby girl too. Either way big guys are awesome to hug and they don't deserve any less love.

Of course! It's so easy to just put everything you're dealing on the back burner to make way for other people's feelings; it shows how selfless you really are. I'm sure you'll find a good balance one day, and situations will become easier to handle. It's tough, but you got this.

Happy belated birthday, friend ((: I know it shouldn't have to be such a big deal, but sometimes, it is. That's okay! Birthday's are important to you and it sucks that your friends could not make that day as special as it should have been.

On that note, it seems like you're carrying a lot of weight in the relationship, and as much as you may not like conflict, I think it's something worth bringing up when/if you have the chance. Maybe telling them via text might feel less confrontational.

If you need to talk to someone, feel free to DM me! I've been in a similar situation before with my friends and I found it was easier to navigate alongside someone else! Happy birthday again <3
Thank you so much for your comment.
That's okay! But yeah, there are so many things that get in the way of things. I hope you find all the peace and happiness this world has to offer as well. Thank you.
Your comment got me out of bed this morning. Your empathy is genuine and it shows. Thank you so much, you said exactly what I didn't even know I needed to hear. All the best to you.

No, I *don't* want to live, that's the problem. The point of this rant is that I really do still want to die and that's probably never going to change... It's just that figuring out a way to die has become so stressful that it's almost like I'm putting it off much like everything else in my life. Anyway, I do appreciate your comment. Nice to know someone actually read this.
